{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
customer_segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(completed_orders['channel'], completed_orders['customer_segment'])
print(customer_segment_by_channel)"}
